llm_rationale: Fish weight is the body mass of an individual fish, while the column is the model-standardized aggregate biomass of a trawl event's catch; no candidate names that variable and the search returned nothing closer, so the vocabulary likely lacks the concept.
llm_missing_context: What the model standardizes for, such as fishing effort or swept area, so the new term can be defined precisely.
llm_bundle_summary: model-standardized aggregate catch biomass in kilograms for a trawl event
llm_new_term_definition: The aggregate biomass of the catch from one trawl event after model-based standardization, expressed as a mass.
